verdict.rationale: AWS documents a Cost Explorer API for programmatically querying cost and usage data, which covers the core 'queryable, not just a dashboard' need. Nothing in the pack shows scheduled cost exports or resource-level granularity. Budgets alerting and the CLI are adjacent and do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring cost data exports, resource-level granularity of cost data, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot

citations.quote: You can use the Cost Explorer API to programmatically query your cost and usage data.
